actions.description:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks):

At will: Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Ice Knife (level 2 version), Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)
1/day each: Control Weather, Ice Storm (level 7 version), Teleport, Zone of Truth
actions.name: Spellcasting

additionalAbilities.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)

additionalAbilities.description:
The region containing an adult or ancient silver dragon's lair is changed by its magic, creating the following effects:
- Gentle Gusts. Winds buoy creatures that fall within 1 mile of the lair. Such creatures descend at a rate of 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.
- Sun and Storms. While in its lair, the dragon can cast Control Weather, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action.

If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.
additionalAbilities.name: Regional Effects

additionalAbilities.description: Reiko has four blessings: Rend, Resistance Aura, Charm and Alter Terrain. These blessings last until the start of Reiko's next turn. Her ability DC is 23.
additionalAbilities.name: Four Blessings

additionalAbilities.description:
Reiko alters the land until the start of her next turn. The DM handles the terrain.
Difficult Terrain: All ground movement costs an extra 5 feet of movement.
Body of Water: Before moving, make a DC 23 Athletics check, then move at half speed.
Gentle Meadow: At the start of a creature's turn in the meadow, it regains 20 HP.
Rocky Terrain: Rocky ground and pillars. The DM handles the layout and all terrain consequences.

Failure or Success: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
